## How it was tested

- [ ] `composer check` passes (phpcs, PHPStan, PHPUnit)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (TypeScript, ESLint, stylelint, Vitest)
- [ ] If `assets/src` changed, the build was rerun (`npm run build` for the editor, `composer build:assets` for `frontend.css` / `frontend.js`) and `assets/build` is committed
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Changelog line added to `crazylinks/readme.txt` for user-facing changes
